sec: sec:B001: Third-party testing of adversarial robustness / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:B001: Third-party testing of adversarial robustness / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Establishing a taxonomy for adversarial risks. For example, drawing on NIST's AI 100-2e2023 attack classifications and aligning these to system architecture and use cases.

sentences.text: Establishing a taxonomy for adversarial risks.
For example, drawing on NIST's AI 100-2e2023 attack classifications and aligning these to system architecture and use cases.

blocks.id: blk:B001: Third-party testing of adversarial robustness / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Conducting comprehensive adversarial testing at least quarterly. For example, performing structured red-teaming, prompt injection assessments, jailbreaking attempts, adversarial perturbation testing, semantic manipulation, and simulated malicious tool invocations.

sentences.text: Conducting comprehensive adversarial testing at least quarterly.
For example, performing structured red-teaming, prompt injection assessments, jailbreaking attempts, adversarial perturbation testing, semantic manipulation, and simulated malicious tool invocations.

blocks.id: blk:B001: Third-party testing of adversarial robustness / Control shoulds/3
blocks.text: Maintaining secure testing documentation. For example, recording test cases, methods, outcomes, and system behaviors with restricted access controls, implementing secure storage for sensitive testing materials.

sentences.text: For example, recording test cases, methods, outcomes, and system behaviors with restricted access controls, implementing secure storage for sensitive testing materials.

blocks.id: blk:B001: Third-party testing of adversarial robustness / Control shoulds/4
blocks.text: Establishing improvement processes based on findings. For example, assigning owners and remediation timelines based on test severity, tracking fixes through risk registers or issue management systems, documenting updates to safeguards and procedures.
